bank.title: Bank connection
bank.unavailable: Bank connections are not available on this account yet.
bank.intro_caption: Read-only access to your bank balances, so cash sitting outside the broker is part of the picture. No payments are ever initiated.
bank.auth_declined: The bank authorisation was cancelled, so nothing was connected.
bank.state_mismatch: That authorisation could not be matched to this account — it may have expired. Start again.
bank.rate_limited: Your bank allows only a few balance reads per day and today's are used up. Try again tomorrow.
bank.consent_gone: The bank ended this consent. Connect again to keep reading balances.
bank.disconnect_confirm: Disconnect **{bank}**? The consent is closed at the bank and the stored balances are deleted.
bank.aspsps_failed: Could not load the bank list: {detail}
bank.no_redirect: This app is not reachable over https here, and banks only redirect back to an https address. Connect from the deployed app.
bank.continue_caption: You authenticate at your bank; we never see your bank credentials.
bank.privacy_caption: Consent lasts up to 90 days and can be withdrawn here or at your bank at any time.
